source.evidence_paths: Relative paths in evidence name files of the repository that recorded the entry; the copied entries keep the paths they had.

decisions.rationale: Candidates within two percent of minimum cost are treated as practically tied before residual margin breaks the tie.
The order favors science margin, then exposure, then the simpler rank and multiplier when forecast cost is practically tied.
The tolerance defines a closed upper bound, so equality passes.

An exclusion takes the most favorable value of an unmeasured quantity. Where the correlation time is measured, the booked gain is a measurement; where it is only bounded or at the cap, no admissible minimum is defined for the archive, so an exclusion reads G = 1 (r_sys_incoherent).

decisions.units: background rank of the fine families
decisions.rationale: The fine families the verdict reads: every rank the detector enumerates. A fixed rank (the declared order-statistic change fixes rho = 63) is a change of this value alone.

The first step that matches decides a band: a band without a tolerance, or whose detector surface is refused, is undetermined; a keep needs a certified false-alarm limit; an excision needs every family empty and an R that does not only measure the floor.
Where the floor is not verified, an R whose least candidate keeps floor-bounded frames on this share or more measures the measurement's sensitivity, not the interference, and cannot excise.
An unmeasured quantity is read at its most favorable value when excising and at its least favorable value when keeping, so neither verdict rests on an assumption in its own favor.
